publicLiability.description: Covers TCD's liability if a third party suffers injury or property damage due to TCD's activities
publicLiability.applies: All installation activities, showroom visitors, on-site project coordination
publicLiability.renewal: Annual — review with broker each renewal

productLiability.description: Covers TCD if a product supplied causes injury or property damage
productLiability.importance: Critical — as a supplier of commercial furniture, product liability exposure is ongoing

marineCargoInsurance.description: Covers goods in transit from supplier warehouse to Australian client site
marineCargoInsurance.coverage: Institute Cargo Clauses (A) — all risks, not just named perils
marineCargoInsurance.perShipment: Ensure cover matches shipment value — update sum insured as order volumes grow
marineCargoInsurance.applies: Activates at point of loading, remains active until delivery accepted by client

businessInterruptionInsurance.description: Covers revenue loss if TCD cannot operate due to an insured event (fire, flood, etc.)
businessInterruptionInsurance.indemnityPeriod: Minimum 12 months — covers revenue plus ongoing fixed costs during recovery

managementLiabilityInsurance.description: Covers directors and officers against claims arising from management decisions
managementLiabilityInsurance.recommendation: Consider when company has 5+ employees or external investors

insuranceForContractors.requirement: Every installation subcontractor must provide certificate of current Public Liability Insurance ($10M minimum) before commencing work
insuranceForContractors.verification: Sight the actual certificate — do not accept verbal confirmation
insuranceForContractors.expiry: Check expiry date — many contractors let policies lapse; verify at each engagement

claimsProcedure.transitDamage: Photograph damage immediately. Notify freight insurer within 48 hours. Do not dispose of damaged goods until insurer has assessed.
claimsProcedure.publicLiabilityClaim: Record the incident in writing immediately. Notify insurer within 24 hours. Do not admit liability.
claimsProcedure.productDefect: Record defect details with photos. Notify product liability insurer. Contact supplier for warranty claim. Do not discard the product.

insuranceCostBenchmarks.publicAndProductLiability: $2,500–$5,000/year for $10M cover at TCD's revenue level
insuranceCostBenchmarks.businessInterruption: $3,000–$7,000/year depending on coverage period and revenue
